notes.title: Update on March 6, 2024
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following

[list]
[*] When you acquire ingredients or charms, we have made it so that you will be notified.

[*] Modified so that if a communication error occurs at the start of the game, you should exit once and attempt to rejoin.
[*] Fixed a problem where entering a room as a spectator after the person who created the room has left would result in an error.
[*] Fixed an issue where other players' otherworldly ingredients were being displayed in the history and inventory screens when set not to always show them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the spy's initial charm was not being displayed in the list of charms during CPU battles.
[/list]

Thanks!

notes.title: Update on December 08, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The update includes the following

[list]
[*] Adjusted the timing of the intermediate spy quiz

notes.title: Update: November 18, 2023
notes.notes:
An update for "Hodgepodge Hunch" is now available.
The main contents of the update are balance adjustments and in-game bug fixes.

The updates are as follows

・The game has been adjusted so that players will not be matched with the same ghost as many times in a row as possible.

Thanks!

notes.title: Tips about Spies

This is the 8th video of "Hodgepodge Hunch" commentary by Uracon.

This time, he introduces a collection of techniques that will be useful if you become a spy.

notes.title: What is an archetype?
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2ciQA2z81fg;full][/previewyoutube]

In this video, We will introduce a feature called "archetype," which allows players to freely replace ingredients and amulets that appear in the game. This archetype is not easy to understand at first glance, but it is an important element for the host player to flexibly adjust the balance of the game.

Knowing the components of the archetype is necessary to strategize how to score the pot. It also affects the excitement of the game. Please watch the video and prepare yourself for the upcoming pot creation!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313160/

notes.title: Learn the rules while enjoying the game!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=rqoUCgOSzUY;full][/previewyoutube]

This is the sixth video of the "Hodgepodge Hunch" instructional video.
This time, we will introduce a feature that is beneficial when inviting a friend who is new to the game.

Games like this one are challenging for novice players who do not know the rules. Therefore, we have included measures in each game mode to help beginners understand "Hodgepodge Hunch" in an easy-to-understand manner, whether they are playing solo or in multiplayer.

The duration of the video is 3 minutes and 14 seconds. If you are interested in this game but don't know exactly what kind of game it is, please watch this video.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313160/

notes.title: Forbidden ingredients
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XMiDK-mlgfY;full][/previewyoutube]

This is the fifth video explaining "Hodgepodge Hunch".
This time, we will talk about "Forbidden ingredients," which are unique ingredients used in the Hunch.

These ingredients are pictures or illustrations that the player has created, and they appear as ingredients in the game.

They are important ingredients for achieving a high score in the pot, as they have a high score as a single ingredient and also have various effects.

However, there is a demerit: if more than three "Forbidden ingredients" are in a pot, it will become a "dark pot" without question. Therefore, it is necessary to make a high-scoring pot with two "Forbidden Ingredients" in it, and it is also a great opportunity for spies to create a dark pot.

This page explains the effective use of these "Forbidden ingredients" and more.
Please take a look at it when you have a spare moment!

The video is 4 minutes 8 seconds long.

notes.title: Event Exhibit Information
notes.notes:
Hello.
This is Waku Waku Games.
Thank you very much for your attention to [b]"Hodgepodge Hunch"[/b].

This is a port of the game of the same name that was released in 2022 for iOS/Android with free basic gameplay, and has been highly acclaimed by players as a casual game of identity concealment that can be enjoyed both solo and in multiplayer.

The Steam version (compatible with both PC and Mac) will be sold for a fee, but will offer access to all content from the beginning and will also support cross-play with the console version, and we believe that you will surely have an intense moment through playing this title.

In addition to CPU battles, the game also offers a story mode for solo play, allowing players to learn the rules of the game while enjoying the story. We still need a little time before the game goes on sale, but if you are interested in this game, please add it to your wish list so that we can keep you updated on the latest news.

Now, this is a topic for those in the Tokyo area, but we have arranged an opportunity for you to experience "Hodgepodge Hunch" ahead of time on May 3 during the Golden Week holidays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44007770/b48cfac963c83592f5b07ecc31c5d5875976b43f.png[/img]

We will be exhibiting at Polyscape's indie game event "cafe IGD's tokyo" to be held on May 3 at Note Place in Gaienmae.
The event will be held from 12:00 to 17:00, and admission is free.

As the name suggests, the lounge will be a space where you can also enjoy coffee. If you are interested in this and other indie game productions, please come and join us.
